name: Coral Reef Kingdom
about: A sunken coral kingdom on one continuous sandy sea bed: glowing coral gardens, tall kelp forest walls, giant open clams with pearls, broken palace columns, with

problems: The floor still reads as a city grid. Lots and paths now share #4a4030, but the lot tiles are still drawn as separate diamonds with darker gutters and edge lines between them. Aerial and ground views show a checkerboard of square plots, not one continuous sandy sea bed.
None of the walk animals (2 dolphins, 2 turtles, fish) appear in any of the three frames. The brief is about befriending dolphins and turtles, so the core story is missing.
The diving_mask still reads as black-rimmed glasses on a man in a t-shirt (ground level). There is no snorkel, no strap behind the head and no oval faceplate, so he doesn't read as a diver.
The giant clams are small grey domes, about knee-high to the diver. They are closed and have no pearls, so they read as rocks or helmets, not giant open clams.
The kelp is thin, wispy and grey-green, about the diver's height or shorter. It reads as dead weeds, not tall kelp forest walls.
The palace columns are plain charcoal posts that read as bollards or lamp posts. There is no capital, base or fluting, and no broken top.

for: A coral reef kingdom under the sea where a young diver (wearing the diving_mask hat) befriends dolphins and sea turtles; coral gardens, kelp, giant clams
